positive_snippets: Much love from Texas. Stayed here in 2023 and again when I returned to India in April 2025. This is my favorite place to stay in New Delhi. Clean rooms, professional and courteous staff. Comfortable rooms, cold air conditioning, televisions, great comfortable beds and furniture. Hot showers. I will be back again! It's Perfect.

We booked all the rooms for three nights  for our guests for daughter marriage and everyone's appraised for excellent hospitality, hygiene and staff efficient service level and attitude. We were happy to opt for Hideaway among various options and recommend with an unbiased mind.
